create_Launcher_for_slurm: create a Launcher instance to schedule StopesModule jobs on a Slurm cluster with retries
schedule_StopesModule_with_Launcher: schedule a StopesModule using the Launcher to run single or array jobs on the cluster
configure_throttle_with_ThrottleConfig: configure a ThrottleConfig to limit parallel job submissions across processes using a shared semaphore
wait_for_Task_result: wait on a Task instance and retrieve its final_result after the job completes
handle_TaskExecutionError_on_failure: handle a TaskExecutionError when a StopesModule job fails on the Slurm cluster
